title: Your first open sound
summary: Pluck once, listen, and let the sound fade.

steps.title: Your first open sound
steps.body:
**pluck** means pull a string a little and release it so it vibrates

**Why it matters:** It is how you start a single sound.

**open string** means a string played with no finger pressing it

**Why it matters:** It is the easiest starting sound on each string.

Leave your fretting hand relaxed. Use your picking hand to pluck string 6 once. Let it ring, then touch it gently to stop it. Tap the lit place on the screen if you do not have a guitar.

steps.title: Look and listen
steps.body: Press Hear it for a reference. Pluck the thickest open string gently. You can tap its lit circle instead. The microphone button in the header is optional; it listens to one sound at a time.

items.prompt: Play the lit note. Tap it here, or play one string with the microphone.

steps.title: Take your time
steps.body: Pluck an open string softly, listen, then stop it with a gentle touch. Leave the other strings quiet. Take your time.
